name: Heroic
author: Flavio F
summary: Heroic is an Open Source Game Launcher for Linux, Windows and MacOS.
description:
Heroic is an Open Source Game Launcher for Linux, Windows (Beta) and MacOS (Limited to Windows games using Wine/Crossover).
Right now it supports launching games from the Epic Games Store using Legendary, a CLI alternative to the Epic Games Launcher.
Heroic is built with Web Technologies like:
TypeScript, React, NodeJS and Electron.

verification.label: Hashes copied from upstream package manifests (winget-pkgs, Homebrew cask). Not independently re-computed; signatures not checked. Linux (Flatpak) installs come from Flathub, whose repository is signed; Flathub publishes no file checksum.
